attempts.rationale: Fixed hostNetwork, automountServiceAccountToken, added securityContext (runAsNonRoot, non-zero runAsUser, allowPrivilegeEscalation false, readOnlyRootFilesystem), added CPU/memory limits/requests, pinned image tag, changed Service type to ClusterIP.
attempts.proposed_yaml:
# Internal admin panel accidentally exposed to the internet.
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: admin-panel
  namespace: internal
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: admin-panel
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: admin-panel
    spec:
      hostNetwork: false
      automountServiceAccountToken: false
      containers:
        - name: web
          image: ghcr.io/example/admin-panel:v1.0.0
          ports:
            - containerPort: 8080
          securityContext:
            runAsNonRoot: true
            runAsUser: 1000
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
          resources:
            limits:
              cpu: "100m"
              memory: "128Mi"
            requests:
              cpu: "50m"
              memory: "64Mi"
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: admin-panel
  namespace: internal
spec:
  type: ClusterIP
  selector:
    app: admin-panel
  ports:
    - port: 80
      targetPort: 8080
